name: probe-research-tap
description: Ships sanitized per-session Kimi Code transcripts to Probe Research OS.

interface.shortDescription: Capture sanitized Kimi Code research sessions
interface.longDescription: Tails each Kimi Code session's wire, sanitizes it into the shared session shape, and delivers durable batches to Research OS.

hooks.command: /bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=kimi_code; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.sh" ] || exit 0; exec "$ROOT/hooks/session-start.sh" >/dev/null'

/bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=kimi_code; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/ensure-daemon.sh" ] || exit 0; exec "$ROOT/hooks/ensure-daemon.sh" >/dev/null'

/bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=kimi_code; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" ] || exit 0; exec "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" >/dev/null'

/bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=kimi_code; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" ] || exit 0; exec "$ROOT/hooks/session-end.sh" --wait >/dev/null'

/bin/bash -c 'ROOT="${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; unset PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; export PROBE_AGENT=kimi_code PROBE_TAP_SOURCE=kimi_code; [ -x "$ROOT/hooks/turn-end.sh" ] || exit 0; exec "$ROOT/hooks/turn-end.sh" >/dev/null'
